title: DeepSAGE: Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2608.22615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based counseling agents can generate fluent and supportive responses, but they often lack the structured, goal-directed progression required to conduct a coherent therapeutic session. We present DeepSAGE (Strategic AI Guidance Engine), a hybrid LLM--Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework for stage-aware counseling dialogue grounded in the first session of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). DeepSAGE represents the session as eleven stages with explicit therapeutic objectives, with an external controller determines stage completion and the DRL model selects therapeutic intentions that guide LLM response generation. We evaluate DeepSAGE against six retrieval-, prompting-, stage-, and policy-based alternatives. DeepSAGE elicits higher simulated client engagement and openness and achieves the strongest balance of stage-goal completion and dialogue efficiency among stage-structured systems. Domain expert review

translated_title: 深度SAGE：面向结构化CBT咨询对话的阶段感知强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22615v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：基于大型语言模型（LLM）的咨询代理能够生成流畅且支持性的回应，但它们往往缺乏进行连贯治疗性会谈所需的结构化、目标导向的进展。我们提出了DeepSAGE（战略人工智能引导引擎），这是一种混合LLM-深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于以认知行为疗法（CBT）首次会谈为基础进行阶段感知的咨询对话。DeepSAGE将会谈表示为具有明确治疗目标的十一个阶段，外部控制器确定阶段完成情况，DRL模型选择引导LLM响应生成的治疗意图。我们将DeepSAGE与六种基于检索、提示、阶段和策略的替代方法进行了评估。DeepSAGE引发了更高的模拟客户参与度和开放性，并在阶段结构化系统中实现了阶段目标完成和对话效率的最强平衡。领域专家评审显示，DeepSAGE在保持结构连贯性的同时，产生了更符合治疗原则的对话。
tldr: DeepSAGE提出了一种将大型语言模型与深度强化学习相结合的混合框架，通过十一个明确的CBT治疗阶段和外部控制器，实现了阶段感知的结构化咨询对话，在提升客户参与度和治疗目标完成度方面优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: DeepSAGE introduces a hybrid LLM-Deep Reinforcement Learning framework with eleven explicit CBT stages and an external controller, achieving stage-aware structured counseling dialogue that outperforms existing methods in client engagement and therapeutic goal completion.
